title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
synopsis: A shepherd boy repeatedly tricks nearby villagers into thinking a wolf is attacking his flock. When a wolf really appears, no one believes his cries and the sheep are lost.

title: The Tortoise and the Hare
synopsis: An overconfident hare mocks a slow tortoise and challenges him to a race. The hare naps mid-race certain of winning, while the tortoise plods on steadily and crosses the finish line first.

title: Cinderella
synopsis: A kind girl mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters dreams of attending the royal ball. With help she goes, loses a glass slipper at midnight, and the prince searches the kingdom to find her.

title: The Ugly Duckling
synopsis: A duckling ridiculed for looking different from his siblings wanders alone through the seasons, until he grows up and discovers he was a beautiful swan all along.

title: Little Red Riding Hood
synopsis: A girl walking to her grandmother’s house through the woods talks to a cunning wolf who tricks her, reaches the house first, and disguises himself. She must use her wits to escape danger.

title: The Lion and the Mouse
synopsis: A mighty lion spares a tiny mouse who promises to repay him one day. Later the lion is trapped in a hunter’s net, and the small mouse gnaws through the ropes to set him free.

title: Hansel and Gretel
synopsis: Two siblings abandoned in the forest find a house made of candy belonging to a witch who traps them. Working together and thinking cleverly, they outwit her and find their way home.

title: The Little Mermaid
synopsis: A young mermaid falls in love with a human prince and trades her voice to a sea witch for legs, sacrificing everything she knows for a chance at a life on land.
